page.overview:
Who is Abigail Hall?

Abigail Hall was a former surgeon who blamed Batman for ruining her life. She created the villainous identity Shush to take revenge on him.

Abigail was a surgeon mentored by Tommy Elliot. At Tommy's request, Abigail covered for him on shifts while he attended to private matters, unwittingly aiding his activities as Hush. When Tommy was unmasked by Batman, Abigail's role covering up his absences was discovered. For her role in Hush's schemes, she was fired and lost her medical license. Left with no other options, she became a teacher at Gotham High School.

Consumed by bitterness over losing her medical career, Abigail was drawn to Man-Bat's cult. Man-Bat convinced Abigail to take on the identity of Shush and work with him achieve his vision for Gotham in exchange for his aid in taking down Batman.

Abigail's first act as Shush was orchestrating the kidnapping of Dr. Kafira, a scientist whose DNA-sequencing work Man-Bat needed. When Batman and Robin attempted to defend Dr. Kafia, Shush shot Batman with a gas pellet that altered his pheromones so bats would attack him.
